reasoning: The retrieved policy fragment ACME-POL-CCPD-001 §4 (Automated Decisioning Disclosures) directly addresses transparency for outcomes materially influenced by automated systems: it requires a customer-facing statement that automated processing was used and a route to request human review. That is a clear, specific transparency requirement and therefore indicates a potential impact with respect to Article 13(1). ACME-POL-CCPD-001 §3 (Product Disclosure Requirements) also shows general transparency practices (product description, risks, fees, contact details), which is relevant background. However, the fragments do not define the “appropriate type and degree of transparency” called for in Article 13(1) nor do they map transparency obligations to the (unsupplied) detailed obligations in Section 3 of the regulation. Missing details include: which parties (provider vs deployer) must provide which disclosures; the required level of detail and format of disclosures; timing/cadence (pre-contractual, real-time, post-decision); evidence/recordkeeping to demonstrate compliance; accessibility/language/placement requirements; and whether disclosures must cover model governance, performance, limitations, or risk mitigation measures. Because the policy contains relevant, specific items (notably §4) but lacks the full set of elements the Article appears to require, this is a potential impact that warrants Compliance Analyst review and possible policy elaboration.

retrieved_fragments.excerpt:
Product disclosure documents must include:

- A description of the product and its intended use
- Key risks associated with the product
- Fees and charges
- Contact details for customer support and complaints

retrieved_fragments.policy_title: Acme Bank Customer Communications and Product Disclosure Policy
retrieved_fragments.excerpt:
Where a product decision (e.g. an application outcome) is materially influenced by
an automated system, the customer-facing communication must include a general
statement that automated processing was used and provide a route to request human
review, in line with existing consumer protection commitments.
